name: ShadowCascadeRender
signature: void (SceneR*, ?, Base* b, ..., u32 view(p5), ..., Obj* bakedObj(p17), ..., u8 skipListB(p26), ..., u32 cascade(p32), u8 vsm(p33), u8 vsmTile(p34), ...)
description: per cascade (535188 loops 1+2) or per VSM tile/batch (1F8340): meshlet culling (9AC33C/52E424, MeshletInstanceCulling 53FD3C, MeshletPreculling 5301FC, end 53007C) then DrawListWalk of list A (slots 2-5, two sub-passes) and list B (slots 11-14, when p26==0); baked path when p25 and bit(cascade) of b2+EA0h; 3278 B

name: ShadowCascadeRender_RetDrawListWalk
description: return site of a DrawListWalk call inside ShadowCascadeRender; 2-7 % of DrawListWalk self samples in r5-r7 profiles

name: SceneRenderView_CallCascadeLoop1
description: cascade loop 1 (first shadow occlusion phase) call of ShadowCascadeRender; marker 'Cascade %d' before it

name: SceneRenderView_CallCascadeLoop2
description: cascade loop 2 (after GenerateShadowMapHiZ, second occlusion phase); passes the same skipListB arg as loop 1 (dec_535188.c:1560): hypothesis H1 / design A2

name: VsmClipmapRender
description: CPU per-tile VSM path, only when base+1AC678 == 5 (markers VirtualShadowmap, Clipmap %d, Clear Tile %d %d, Batch Tiles %d, Tile %d %d); returns early for modes 1 and 6; renders dirty+requested+uncached tiles up to VsmTilesPerFrameBudget via ShadowCascadeRender; 5021 B

name: ViewShadowListA

name: ViewShadowListB

name: ViewVsmListA

name: ViewVsmListB

name: DrawListCount

name: VsmTileNeedsRender

name: VsmTileDirty

name: VsmTileRequested

name: VsmTilesPerFrameBudget

name: VsmTileMarkRendered

name: VsmTileBindViewport

name: MeshletCullBegin

name: MeshletCullBeginAlt
description: alternative culling setup (when obj+1ECh != 0)

name: MeshletInstanceCullingRecord

name: MeshletCullEnd
description: resets the culling state, emits 3 x token 0x8A (UAV barrier)

name: GenerateShadowMapHiZ
description: marker GenerateShadowMapHiZ + Hi-Z build between the two shadow occlusion phases

name: VsmPassNodeExecute

name: VsmPassExecute

name: VsmClipmapSetup
